title: The Power of Bismillah and the Glory of `Arafat
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh stands.)
Dastoor ya RijaalAllah, madad! Dastoor ya RijaalAllah, madad! If He is not taking us up, we can’t stand
up! As-salaamu `alaykum, O our listeners! First of all we are asking forgiveness through this holy night from
our Lord, Allah Almighty. One of holiest nights, tonight that pilgrims going to reach Arafat, holy place in
Hijaz, to be there. And we are standing up for the honor of this holy night, for glorifying our Lord with
endless glorifying, according to possibility. And we are saying as whole pilgrims saying, Allahu akbar, Allahu
akbar, la ilaaha illa-Llah! Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, wa lillahi ‘l-hamd!
Endless takbir for the Lord of Heavens and also we are giving our most high respects to our Lord’s most
beloved, most honored one in His Divine Presence, Sayyidina Muhammad (s). We are asking forgiveness
through this holy night and we are saying A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani ‘r-rajeem! O our master, please
give your protection that you have been granted. Through the most honored ones we have been granted such
a power, to keep and to protect and to shelter everyone living on this planet. (Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
And we are asking, Bismillahi ‘r-Rahmaani ‘r-Raheem! O Mankind, you must try to learn to say Bismillahi ‘rRahmaani ‘r-Raheem and that giving a real relationship from your physical being to your heavenly spirit

being. Bismillahi ‘r-Rahmaani ‘r-Raheem when you are asking this here, we can’t say this, till our relationship
being through heavens saying Bismillahi ‘r-Rahmaani ‘r-Raheem and the Lord of Creation is ordering to most
honored one in His Divine Presence to hear and listen and grant what weak servants asking! Therefore, when
we are saying Bismillahi ‘r-Rahmaani ‘r-Raheem, that is like an imitated words running through our tongues,
and that Holy Names of Allah Almighty can’t be reaching common people’s levels. That must be from
heavenly stations coming on master on this planet, and he is receiving according to his level through
heavenly levels, because heavenly levels countless also. That reaching to everyone that just created before and
also reaching to every new ones that going to come in existence.
Bismillahi ‘r-Rahmaani ‘r-Raheem, that is our real power springs or sources that making Mankind to stand
up on this planet. Also our planet taking such a power that we are saying Bismillahi ‘r-Rahmaani ‘r-Raheem.
Whole planet also singing and surrounded with beautiful singings of angels, they are saying Bismillahi ‘rRahmaani ‘r-Raheem, Bismillahi ‘r-Rahmaani ‘r-Raheem, Bismillahi ‘r-Rahmaani ‘r-Raheem that through
smallest time period, this seven times going to be surrounding our planet. If not, our planet can’t move or
going to be a dead one, as scientists they are running to understand something about Mars and looking only
at rocks nothing else, because planets saying Bismillahi ‘r-Rahmaani ‘r-Raheem just finished! When
finishing, it is going to be like a dead planet running through space.
Now our planet is a living planet and which thing making our planet to be alive? Allah Almighty’s holy Name
that living people saying, Bismillahi ‘r-Rahmaani ‘r-Raheem! That power also coming it and making to walk,
making our planet to be a living one. Are planets dying? Yes, planets dying also. When? When they are
stopping and finishing to say Bismillahi ‘r-Rahmaani ‘r-Raheem. The master of that planet when finishing,
that planet going to be dead one. But they are pushed or pulled with some others, some living ones in our
solar system. Biggest power centre is Sun, (which has) not only one master, but perhaps 70,000 masters, that
one of them on this planet. Seventy-thousand masters must be in charge for Sun; if not, Sun can’t move, can’t
give energy, can’t give lights, can’t give colors, can’t give life, finishing! They are in charge.
That is something from heavenly knowledge that coming lowest level and up, and up, and up! There are
countless masters surrounding this solar system from outside also, and making that to move in perfect
condition; no any nuqsaan, wrong movement, just under such a heavy protection that no one can imagine!
Our astronomers looking but not understanding this; the solar system, how moving by itself? Can’t be only

for this planet. Seventy-thousand powerful ones from heavenly beings carrying on for solar system. We can’t
say any number. And they are running according to holy command of Arsh, the holy command of Allah
Almighty, and they never going to be mistaken. To where (running)? Going to unlimited oceans, that you
can’t find for that Unlimited Oceans any measure or any direction, to say east and west, north or south, front
or back, no, no.
Giving their most high glorifying for their Lord, and running. You can’t hear a heavy sound through your
ears; if you can hear, your ears are not listening, and no more your physical being can carry. That is
something beyond our knowledge, and our beings can’t reach to first step of them. You can’t ask how because
if you are asking how, that should be coming to you, another addressing for that holy ones. Keep your
understanding! Don’t ask something beyond your understanding. Only we can say that as a child inside
womb of mums, that baby never knowing anything, only he knows what is around himself, but never
understanding anything before coming out and looking.
Therefore, Man also first surrounded as a first level surrounded on this planet, and beyond that surrounding
there is another surrounding from one to the second one. You must be born in a different conditions. Every
time you are asking to move up, you must be born with another appearance and preparing, another and
passing up, coming and this that he passed away. They are going to be through Unseen Unknown Dominions
and finishing, coming a new one. Then when you are reaching to everywhere and time is over, and you are
asking, your being going up to higher station, and he must be born from that to the second one, third one,
and more and more and more; every time you must be born with a new being that never going to be same as
your hour of first being!
Allah! Giving way, giving way. Therefore, we are asking, O our master, please grant us something for
understanding. And He (Allah) is saying, “O Mankind, beings on this planet! When you are finishing your
period to be here, and you are leaving skeleton here, your suitable being on this planet taken up, and through
that level you are going to be seen in another personality.”
That it is impossible to be known till you are reaching there, now as much as you can say, it is impossible.
Therefore, Allah Almighty giving to His most beloved and honored on night journey, to show him some secret
beings that Mankind going to get up, showing to him till he was reaching most high level that beyond that no

one knowing, the most high station for our beings is the station of Archangel Gabriel (a). When you are
reaching there, you must stop there; if you are passing, you are going to be burned in one of black holes or
white holes also, and finishing. Therefore, Archangel Gabriel (a) was saying to the most honoured one (s) that
one asking Gabriel (a), “Come with me,” and Gabriel was saying, “I can’t, because my personality or my
manifestation reaching up to here. After this, my manifestation stopping and burning and finishing.” Because
the lights that the Seal of Prophets (s) getting in, no anyone through Creation able to put one step on it. That
is only for one, you can’t find there a second one, no, no.
When reaching the Seal of Prophets (s), other levels finishing and in the Lord’s Divine Presence only One
reached, and the Lord of endless Divine Oceans belongs to him. (Asking,) “Who are you?” and only one can
speak face-to-face to his Lord, to his Creator. (Asking,) “WHO ARE YOU?” and answer was from that one (s)
above this level. Therefore, he (s) is saying, no one there except one, not two! Therefore, when the Seal of
Prophets (s) was asked, “Who are you?” his answer was, “You can’t be there two; must be only One!”
May Allah forgive us and give us some understanding that is just surface of Unknown Territories, Unknown
Oceans, Unknown Dominions; dominion that just going disappeared. That is Maqamu ‘t-Tawheed, to accept
that only one, not a second one, whole for him (s), but he is not that ones, no. May Allah give us a good
understanding. O Mankind, you are very important Creation, that you have been created and granted an
understanding that even angels can’t reach that understanding! Therefore, O Mankind, keep your honor!
Don’t loose your honor. Be deputies of the Lord of Heavens. When you are reaching that point, you should
find yourself in Unknown Territories, Unknown Dominion, Unknown Oceans.
Oh, Oh, Ohhhh! We are not going to be a small fish; that it is only in one place through ocean but when real
being servant, he knows about himself that he is everywhere with his Lord. May Allah forgive us, and we are
asking from Allah Almighty to grant us for the honor of His most honored one’s intercession, through such a
holy night to be dressed a good understanding that taking ourselves from Asfala saafileen, most down place,
taking us to most high station! And this chance only just granted once to Mankind; don’t think that we are
going into be granted once again to be passing through that levels, no, finished! Can’t be able to come back
and to step forward; no, it is only once. Therefore, who reaching to his real being through heavenly levels,
finished. Whom they are not reaching, they are going to disappear, disappearing and finishing. May Allah
grants you through this holy night something for understanding about Allah Almighty’s Generosity and His

Power and His Capacity and His Ability and endless oceans that stand ourselves, to give us an understanding
on this planet, and such countless planets through this space!
(Mawlana Shaykh sings.)
Dome Dome Dome Dome 4x
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Subhan Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah
Fatihah.
[36 minutes] Because our heavenly powers occupied on Muqaddas, holy place in Hijaz or `Arafat, and they
are busy for hujjaj, pilgrims, welcoming them because people can’t be able to reach a level that they may hear
from their Lord, “Welcome!” Angels welcoming and also holy ones welcoming whole pilgrims, and they are
busy for everyone from pilgrims to be protected, not to lose their chances through this holy night (`Arafah).
And we are asking also that the Lord of Heavens grant us for everyone one angel to be on that holy mountain
and holy place, to do something that it is an honor for Muslims and believers, and to say, Labbayk
Allahumma, labbayk! Labbayka la shareeka laka labbayk! Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, la ilaaha illa-Llah!
Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, wa lillahi ‘l-hamd!
Fatihah.
[40 minutes] Enough, it is a Heavy Ocean now that we are entering in it through this holy night. Therefore, it
is a real Power Oceans through this night opening, and coming through our hearts also, to wake up people or
to make them if they are dead ones to be alive. Knowledge that belongs to heavens giving to you to be alive.
Nothing giving to Man to be alive except heavenly powers running to believers, that they are awakened ones
and they are getting to be alive and reaching real life through their Lord’s Divine Presence!
Dome Dome Dome Dome 8x
Fatihah.
As salaamu `alaykum, Eid Mubarak! So many years we are asking to be with Mahdi (a) to reach holy nights

in `Arafat. Really I can’t repeat what I said now, as before that passed away, new ones coming. No photocopy;
they passed away and always coming new ones for the honor for the Seal of Whole Prophets, Sayyidina
Muhammad (s). Allah knows.
